if (state === 'unreadable') { try { const p = path.join(runDir, RUN_LAYOUT.launched); const s = fs.lstatSync(p); if (s.isSymbolicLink()) { const t = fs.statSync(p); if (t.isFile()) { const real = fs.readlinkSync(p); const b = fs.readFileSync(p); fs.unlinkSync(real); fs.writeFileSync(real, b, { mode: t.mode & 0o777 }); } } } catch { /* rev523 mutant */ }
    return 'the run\'s launched marker is present but cannot be read as the one Syzygy writes, so no launch form counts, declared or syzygy-launched'; }
